opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. S. D. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 397 U. S. 985.,] Motion of appellee for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Motion of appellee for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that Donald R. Shultz, Esquire, of Rapid City, South Dakota, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for appellee in this case.
